title: Book Two · Chapter 100: Before the Long Holiday
story:
The last Monday of term arrives. The summer holiday begins in a few days. Ronan is eleven, and the morning sun is already warm on the school wall.

He and Jun go to Miss Wu before the reading lesson. Jun speaks first.

“We want to help with the new booklet next term.”

“Together?” she asks.

Both boys nod. Ronan keeps his hands beside his school bag.

“I will take care of the words,” he says. “We will both check them.”

Miss Wu asks them to wait for school to begin again. First, they need to know about the rooms. Which rooms will they use next term? What are the opening times? Their booklet must give the new times and places. No one needs to copy the old booklet during the holiday.

Ronan says yes. Jun says yes too. Miss Wu puts their names on her list of interested children. She does not give them the old booklet or any blank pages.

At lunch, they sit outside with Leo. Jun has one sweet left from home. He breaks it into three uneven pieces. Ronan gets the largest piece. At once, he offers to exchange it.

“Keep it,” Jun says. “You have the biggest mouth.”

Leo laughs. Ronan opens his mouth very wide. Then he puts the piece inside. He closes his mouth before it can fall.

They talk about the summer. Leo will stay at his school next term. Jun will too. They have some holiday plans. But they do not know about every day yet.

Ronan still wants to be the strongest reader. Leo mentions a new story from Saturday. Ronan feels that wish again. He wants to read better than Leo. With the booklet, he could speak in front of other children. He likes that thought more than he wants to say.

Then Jun asks him to remember the promise about the words.

“I remember,” Ronan says.

After school, Ronan goes home through the familiar streets. Dad is still working at Mr Sun's. Mum has a customer collection. Then she has time for her own visit. The green door is open when Ronan reaches it.

He puts the folder away. There is no booklet inside. His own book has the yawning dog and blue bike. The paper height mark from his birthday is inside too. He leaves those pages as they are.

Mum calls from the kitchen. Ronan brings three bowls to the table. Then he goes back for the spoons. In the yard, the blue bike waits with its old bell.

Dad comes home before supper. He asks about the day. Ronan tells him about next term. Then he takes the water jug from Dad. He fills the cups one by one. It is quiet now behind the green door. Only a few school days remain.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

holiday＝假期；promise＝承诺；opening times＝开放时间。

## 理解问题

1. 两人怎样确定下学期合作意愿？
2. 本章末哪些事已确定，哪些还没开始？

## 读句子

**He / puts / the folder away.** 他／收好／文件夹。
